description: VPC Interface Endpoints (PrivateLink) for Amazon Bedrock Runtime, Bedrock control plane, CloudWatch Metrics, CloudWatch Logs, and STS. Enables zero-egress AI operations inside a private VPC.
capabilities: Creates VPC Interface Endpoint for Bedrock Runtime (InvokeModel)
Creates VPC Interface Endpoint for Bedrock control plane
Optionally creates VPC Interface Endpoint for Bedrock Agent Runtime
Creates VPC Interface Endpoint for CloudWatch Metrics
Creates VPC Interface Endpoint for CloudWatch Logs
Creates VPC Interface Endpoint for STS (IAM role assumption)
Creates a shared Security Group controlling access to all endpoints
Enables private DNS on all endpoints — no SDK code changes required
Resolves AWS region automatically — no hardcoded region names
llm_hints: Pass module.networking.subnet_private_ids to subnet_ids — never public subnets
Pass [module.networking.sg_app_id] to allowed_sg_ids to allow the MCP Server to reach endpoints
private_dns_enabled is true on all endpoints — Bedrock SDK calls work without any code changes
Region is auto-resolved — never pass a region variable to this module
Set enable_bedrock_agent=true only if using Bedrock Agents API, not for direct InvokeModel calls
This module must be applied before the MCP Server ECS task — the task needs endpoints to be available
security_notes: All endpoints share one Security Group — ingress port 443 restricted to allowed_sg_ids only
Egress on the endpoint SG is open (required for endpoint ENI health checks) — tfsec ignore applied
private_dns_enabled prevents DNS-based exfiltration to public Bedrock endpoints
No resource outside allowed_sg_ids can reach Bedrock or CloudWatch through these endpoints
